comment: OHSidian engine tuning flags (Chromium switches). touchSlopDistance: tap tolerance, larger = taps register more easily (try 8~48 if buttons are hard to press). forceDeviceScaleFactor: 0 = follow engine default, try 1.25/1.5 if the whole UI is too small on your tablet. extraFlags: raw Chromium switches appended verbatim. ThirdPartyStoragePartitioning disabled (round 96): un-partitions third-party site storage inside embedded web logins (Custom Frames etc.) so cookie-based logins survive restarts; the feature string exists in this engine build. NOTE: a user-editable override file is supported at <filesDir>/ohsidian-flags-user.json (extraFlags only, appended after these, no repack needed; changes take effect after the app restarts - flags are read once per process). VIDEO HARDWARE DECODE (round 95b, withdrawn from defaults in round 95c): the flag --enable-features=PlatformVideoDecoder,kIsPlatformVideoDecoder,PlatformAudioDecoder,kIsPlatformAudioDecoder DID activate the engine's HarmonyOS codec bridge, but device logs proved the closed-source bridge configures the decoder with width/height only (no pixel format) and the HAL rejects it (OH_VideoDecoder_Configure invalid argument), leaving playback hung. Until the engine upstream fixes the bridge, do NOT re-enable it here; put it in ohsidian-flags-user.json only for experiments. HEVC/H.265 in-app playback is blocked by that engine bug - transcode to H.264/MP4 or use the system player (the app shows guidance).
